phase2.a6.planner.title: Week planner
phase2.a6.planner.free_note: Planning costs no time. Nothing changes in your day until you press Resolve this week.
phase2.a6.planner.unavailable: The week cannot be read right now. Go back, resume and try again.
phase2.a6.planner.hint: Tab or the d-pad moves between controls. Page Up and Page Down scroll. Esc or B goes back.
phase2.a6.orders.heading: Standing orders
phase2.a6.orders.empty: No standing orders. Every lesson stays yours to play.
phase2.a6.mode.routine: routine where you have mastered it
phase2.a6.editor.heading: Add or change an order
phase2.a6.editor.attend: Go to school on these days
phase2.a6.editor.hint: Saving changes the preview below, not your day. You can remove an order at any time.
phase2.a6.editor.saved: Order saved. No time was spent.
phase2.a6.editor.removed: Order removed. No time was spent.
phase2.a6.editor.no_days: Choose at least one day first.
phase2.a6.scene.heading: Scene days
phase2.a6.scene.note: You play a scene day yourself: compression stops at its first entry.
phase2.a6.week.heading: The week, as compression would run it
phase2.a6.week.empty: Nothing is planned for the coming days.
phase2.a6.week.problem_fmt: This week cannot be planned yet. {0}
phase2.a6.week.stop_none: Nothing in this plan needs you: it would resolve in full.
phase2.a6.week.stop_fmt: Compression would stop before {0}, {1}. You play it; then resolve again.
phase2.a6.mark.order: Done for you by your standing order.
phase2.a6.mark.first: Your first time at this lesson.
phase2.a6.mark.foreground: Your order says you play each lesson yourself.
phase2.a6.mark.routine_not_ready: Routine is not ready for this lesson yet.
phase2.a6.mark.choice: A choice only you can make.
phase2.a6.mark.choice_spent: A choice only you can make. This week's one interruption is already used.
phase2.a6.resolve.note: Resolving spends the game time the plan shows and stops before anything that needs you.
phase2.a6.recap.heading: What actually happened
phase2.a6.recap.none: No recap yet. A recap shows only what was really resolved in this session; it is never rebuilt afterwards.
phase2.a6.recap.nothing_ran: Nothing was resolved and no game time passed.
phase2.a6.recap.stop_first_fmt: Stopped before your first time at {0}. Play it, then resolve again.
phase2.a6.recap.stop_choice_fmt: Stopped before a choice only you can make: {0}.
phase2.a6.recap.stop_spent_fmt: Stopped before {0}. This week's one interruption was already used, so it is a scene day.
phase2.a6.recap.displaced_fmt: Passed over, as you knew at the time: {0}.
phase2.a6.refusal.unknown: That could not be done. Nothing changed.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.bad_order: That order is not valid. Choose days from Monday to Saturday.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.too_many_o: There are already as many orders as there are school days.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.overlappin: Two orders cannot cover the same day. Edit or remove the other one first.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.missing_ca: The school timetable is not available.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.bad_plan: The week's plan is not valid.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.missing_bi: A lesson in the timetable has no subject set up yet.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.duplicate_: A lesson in the timetable is set up twice.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.busy: A lesson is open. Finish or leave it first.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.bad_lesson: A lesson in the plan does not match the timetable.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.duplicate_: A lesson appears twice in the plan.
phase2.a6.refusal.school.week.clock_refu: The clock could not move. Nothing changed.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.overlap: School time collides with something already planned. Nothing changed.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.world_busy: You are asleep, in the middle of an activity or committed to something. Finish that first.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.no_school: There is no school to go to.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.beyond_calendar: That runs past the end of the school calendar.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.not_routine: This plan includes something that cannot be compressed.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.invalid_world: The day is out of step with the clock.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.unknown_activity: The plan names an activity that does not exist.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.wrong_place: An activity in the plan does not suit where it happens.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.day_command_refus: The day would not accept a step of the plan. Nothing changed.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.clock_refused: The clock could not move. Nothing changed.
phase2.a6.refusal.week.missing_catalogue: The school timetable is not available.
phase2.a6.projection.title: What the school terminal has seen
phase2.a6.projection.note: Unknown means not yet seen. It never means unsuitable, and nothing here limits what you may try.
phase2.a6.projection.unavailable: The terminal cannot be read right now. Go back, resume and try again.
phase2.a6.projection.nothing_seen: Nothing has been observed yet, so every path is unknown.
phase2.a6.projection.unknown_none: Every part of this path has been seen at least once.
phase2.a6.projection.unknown_invite: You can find out by trying it.
phase2.a6.projection.evidence_fmt: Recorded observations that bear on this path: {0}.
phase2.a6.projection.hint: Up and Down choose a path. Esc or B goes back.
